data.title: Dr. Strangelove
data.original_title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb

cast.role: Dr. Strangelove / President Merkin Muffley / Lionel Mandrake

data.synopsis: A general seals off his base and orders the first strike; in the war room the president, the military and a damaged scientist fight over the last hours. Kubrick's comedy about the bomb is one about the men who administer it.
